provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Myself: parts of the body
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to name parts of the body.
The pupils should be able to point to parts of the body.
Introduction:
We have been learning about ourselves.
Today we will learn about body parts.
Content:
Our body has head, hands, legs and more.
The head is on top.
Hands are for holding things.
Legs help us walk.
We can point to our body parts.
Class activity:
Let us play a game.
I say a body part.
You point to it.
Evaluation questions:
Name one body part.
Point to your hand.
What do we use legs for?
Summary:
We have learned about body parts.

topics.title: My senses: eyes and ears
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state what eyes do.
The pupils should be able to state what ears do.
Introduction:
We use our body to see and hear.
Today we learn about eyes and ears.
Content:
Eyes help us see.
We see with our eyes.
Ears help us hear.
We hear with our ears.
We can play games with our eyes and ears.
Class activity:
Let us play I spy.
I spy with my little eye something red.
Evaluation questions:
What do eyes do?
What do ears do?
Name something you see in the classroom.
Summary:
Eyes see and ears hear.

topics.title: My senses: nose, tongue, skin
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state what the nose does.
The pupils should be able to state what the tongue does.
The pupils should be able to state what the skin does.
Introduction:
We have more senses than eyes and ears.
Today we learn about nose, tongue and skin.
Content:
The nose helps us smell.
We smell with our nose.
The tongue helps us taste.
We taste with our tongue.
The skin helps us touch.
We touch with our skin.
Class activity:
Let us sort pictures.
Put pictures of things we smell in one pile.
Put pictures of things we taste in another pile.
Evaluation questions:
What does the nose do?
What does the tongue do?
What does the skin do?
Summary:
We smell with nose, taste with tongue and touch with skin.

topics.title: Living things around me
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify living things.
The pupils should be able to name living things.
Introduction:
Some things around us are alive.
Today we learn about living things.
Content:
Living things grow.
Living things move.
Living things need food.
Plants and animals are living things.
We see plants and animals every day.
Class activity:
Let us name living things.
What living things do you see in the school?
Evaluation questions:
Is a tree a living thing?
Is a stone a living thing?
Name one animal you know.
Summary:
Plants and animals are living things.

topics.title: Non living things around me
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify non living things.
The pupils should be able to name non living things.
Introduction:
Not all things around us are alive.
Today we learn about non living things.
Content:
Non living things do not grow.
Non living things do not move by themselves.
Non living things do not need food.
Stone, water and chair are non living things.
We see non living things every day.
Class activity:
Let us sort pictures.
Put pictures of living things here.
Put pictures of non living things there.
Evaluation questions:
Is water a living thing?
Is a dog a living thing?
Name one non living thing.
Summary:
Non living things do not grow or move by themselves.

topics.title: Plants in my compound
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to name plants.
The pupils should be able to point to plants.
Introduction:
We see plants in our compounds.
Today we learn about plants.
Content:
Plants are living things.
Plants have roots, stem, leaves and flowers.
Grass, flowers and trees are plants.
Plants need water and sunlight to grow.
Class activity:
Let us name and point to plants.
Point to the grass outside.
Point to the flowers in the garden.
Evaluation questions:
Name one plant.
What do plants need to grow?
Is a tree a plant?
Summary:
Grass, flowers and trees are plants.

topics.title: Animals around me
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to name animals.
The pupils should be able to name animal sounds.
Introduction:
We see animals around us.
Today we learn about animals.
Content:
Animals are living things.
Animals move and eat.
Goat, dog and fowl are common animals.
Goat says baa.
Dog says woof.
Fowl says cock-a-doodle-doo.
Class activity:
Let us name animal sounds.
What sound does a goat make?
What sound does a dog make?
Evaluation questions:
Name one animal.
What sound does a fowl make?
Is a cat an animal?
Summary:
Goat, dog and fowl are animals with different sounds.

topics.title: Water and its uses
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state uses of water.
The pupils should be able to talk about clean water.
Introduction:
Water is very important.
Today we learn about water and its uses.
Content:
Water is used for drinking.
Water is used for washing.
Water is used for cooking.
Clean water is good for us.
Dirty water can make us sick.
Class activity:
Let us talk about clean water.
Why is clean water important?
How do we keep water clean?
Evaluation questions:
Name one use of water.
Why do we need clean water?
What do we use water for at home?
Summary:
Water is used for drinking, washing and cooking.

topics.title: Things in the sky
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to name things in the sky.
The pupils should be able to talk about day and night.
Introduction:
We look up and see things in the sky.
Today we learn about things in the sky.
Content:
The sun is in the sky.
The moon is in the sky.
Stars are in the sky.
During the day we see the sun.
At night we see the moon and stars.
Class activity:
Let us talk about day and night.
What do we see during the day?
What do we see at night?
Evaluation questions:
Name one thing in the sky.
What do we see at night?
Is the sun in the sky?
Summary:
The sun, moon and stars are things in the sky.

topics.title: Revision and assessment
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to recall what we learned this term.
The pupils should be able to answer questions about our topics.
Introduction:
Today we revise what we learned this term.
We will have a picture quiz.
Content:
We learned about body parts.
We learned about our senses.
We learned about living and non living things.
We learned about plants and animals.
We learned about water and things in the sky.
Class activity:
Let us have a picture quiz.
I will show pictures.
You tell me what they are.
Evaluation questions:
Name one living thing.
What do we use water for?
What do we see in the sky at night?
Summary:
We have revised what we learned this term.
